Name: Farm Cave Minecart (CP)
Author: UncleArya
Description:
[size=3][size=3]This content pack adds 1 new minecart location to the farm cave, which becomes usable once you unlock the minecarts as normal.[/size]

Works by default with the Vanilla farm cave map.

Compatibility with some modded farm cave maps has been added. Check compatibility list below. There is a "Compatibility Mode" config option that can be enabled to attempt improving general compatibility if not directly added.

[b]Language support for:[/b] English 🇬🇧, German 🇩🇪, Spanish 🇪🇸, Portuguese 🇧🇷🇵🇹, French 🇫🇷, and Chinese 🇨🇳
[b]Can be further localised for any language by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] to enter a custom location name.[/b]
[/size][size=2][size=3]
[b]Compatibilities
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13650]Beach Minecart[/url] - the beach gets added to the minecart destination list if installed.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881]Integrated Minecarts[/url] - highly recommended to use alongside any custom minecart mods and mods
that add additional minecarts (Ridgeside, East Scarp, SVE) as it integrates all minecart networks into one single destination list and allows you to re-order the destination list.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5849]Hot Spring Farm Cave[/url] - if Hot Spring Farm Cave is installed, a compatibility patch should automatically apply
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23190]More Lively Farm Cave[/url] - if More Lively Farm Cave is installed, a compatibility patch should automatically apply
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14109]Additional Farm Cave[/url] - if Additional Farm Cave is installed, a compatibility patch should automatically appl[/size][/size][size=3]y

An additional compatibility patch should also automatically apply if Additional Farm Cave is present with Hot Springs Farm Cave or More Lively Farm Cave.[/size][size=2][size=3]
[/size][/size][size=2][size=3][b]
[/b][b]Credits[/b]
I took motivation from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881]Integrated Minecarts[/url]﻿ to try creating a new minecart location. So huge props to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5639823]Jibblestein[/url]﻿ for creating a very cool mod. Huge thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url] for making CP docs so easy to understand.
